measurementStage: First actual observations after the main application corrections, not a pre-deployment baseline
subsequentChange: Optional unconfirmed postal field removed after all native queries; other contact/price/measurement/delivery facts unchanged. The observation release labels were not rewritten.

integrity.source: Explicit normalized datasets only; raw captures/invalid associations are not appended as extra observations.
integrity.metadataOverlay: Agent semantics normalized separately; raw text, sources and observation dates preserved.

limitations: No native AI answers were collected before deployment; initial AI visibility uplift cannot be computed retrospectively.
ChatGPT discovery19/36 is an observed minimum: one visible Kuhnitver source card could not be resolved to a URL. A link does not establish correct facts or a recommendation.
Gemini18 valid controlled observations cover the first6queries;33remaining slots were unrun after an explicit unusual-traffic block. Capture deviations and3uncontrolled observations are separate.
Giga48 completed observations and3operational timeouts are descriptive only; account personalization was uncontrolled. Late recovery did not produce extra answers or independent repeats.
Perplexity has2complete supplier-1 replies and1signup gate; Copilot required sign-in before any query. These are bounded additional probes.
The Alice standalone chat is supplemental and uncontrolled; it is not the primary quick AI answer in Yandex Search. Ordinary search results are not counted as AI replies.
Physical region and undisclosed model versions were not established; Russian/Tver query context does not prove a Tver-local representative sample.
Text drafts are not website field fills. The tested chat surfaces did not actuate the site, so website-action success is unmeasured; actual browser form acceptance is recorded separately.
Audit-triggered provider fetches and manual source clicks are not organic customer visits. Small non-random samples do not establish causal effects.
